Medium Affected: WATER

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 37.540725, -77.436048 (Approximated from locality)
Report DescriptionCALLER STATES AN ACCIDENT OCCURRED WHERE TOO MUCH FLUORIDE WAS RELEASED INTO THE DRINKING WATER. CITY OF RICHMOND DID NOT TEST THE FLUORIDE LEVELS ON THE DAY OF THE INCIDENT AND DID NOT UNTIL 5 DAYS AFTER. THE CITY OF CHESTERFIELD TESTED THE WATER BECAUSE IT COMES FROM RICHMOND AND THE FLUORIDE LEVELS WERE 3.86 PPM 2 DAYS AFTER THE INCIDENT. THERE WAS A NEWS ARTICLE STATING THAT 66,000 GALLONS OF FLUORIDE WAS RELEASED; HOWEVER THE TANK ALLEGEDLY CAN HOLD 10,000 GALLONS. CALLER STATES RICHMOND WAS NOT TRUTHFUL ABOUT THE LEVEL OF FLUORIDE IN THE WATER. THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT ON 23APR25 IS UNKNOWN.
